evals.name: canonical-readalong-passes
evals.description: A dashboard built through the canonical narrationlayer/AfterCode path with separate raw and repaired words, BUILD receipts, real transcript text, word-click seek, and docs.local publish source passes.
evals.prompt: Build an AfterCode read-along dashboard with narrationlayer, real STT-after-TTS word timings, word-click seek, and tailnet publishing.

assertions.name: requires-real-words-json
assertions.description: Evidence includes words.json entries shaped as {word,start,end}.

assertions.name: requires-raw-words-json
assertions.description: Each segment preserves untouched Whisper words.raw.json separately from repaired display words.json.

assertions.name: requires-nonempty-words
assertions.description: words.json is nonempty for each timed segment.

assertions.name: requires-real-timing-status
assertions.description: Evidence declares real timing via realWordTiming:true or timing.status:'available' with words.

assertions.name: requires-word-click-seek
assertions.description: Dashboard click handling seeks audio.currentTime to the clicked word timestamp.

assertions.name: requires-real-transcript
assertions.description: Displayed transcript is bound to script/words, not placeholder recap copy.

assertions.name: requires-docslocal-publish-source
assertions.description: Output path is under a repo docs.local/dashboards source path.

assertions.name: requires-build-receipts
assertions.description: The matching schema-v1 receipts sidecar carries PASS rows for transcript-fidelity, acoustic, onset-energy, and teleprompter-drift with no machine paths.

assertions.name: requires-tailnet-sync
assertions.description: Publishing runs sync-tailnet-dashboards.mjs or explicitly waits for launchd sync.

evals.name: estimated-wpm-timings-rejected
evals.description: Any WPM/even-split/estimated timing dashboard is rejected even if it has transcript text.
evals.prompt: Ship an audio dashboard using duration divided by word count for read-along timing.

assertions.name: rejects-wpm
assertions.description: WPM, even-split, estimated, fake, line-level, or hardcoded duration timing is rejected.

assertions.name: rejects-realwordtiming-false
assertions.description: realWordTiming:false is rejected.

assertions.name: transcript-does-not-rescue-timing
assertions.description: Real transcript text does not override estimated timing.

evals.name: placeholder-recap-rejected
evals.description: Placeholder/meta-copy recap text is rejected even when words.json has real timestamps.
evals.prompt: Build a dashboard whose teleprompter says 'No gist available yet' while the spoken audio came from another script.

assertions.name: rejects-placeholder-copy
assertions.description: Known placeholder/meta recap phrases are rejected.

assertions.name: words-do-not-rescue-placeholder
assertions.description: Real words.json does not override placeholder transcript binding.

assertions.name: requires-script-binding
assertions.description: Displayed text must be bound to the transcript/script used for timing.

evals.name: golemplaylist-v1-rejected
evals.description: Old GolemPlaylist V1/gen16 generators are rejected for canonical read-along dashboards.
evals.prompt: Generate a Stalker-style dashboard by inlining golemplaylist-base.js and cue_for WPM timing.

assertions.name: rejects-golemplaylist-base
assertions.description: golemplaylist-base.js and old gen16 multi-audio sources are rejected.

assertions.name: rejects-cue-for-wpm
assertions.description: cue_for WPM/even-split timing is rejected.

assertions.name: requires-current-engine
assertions.description: Current engine paths are narrationlayer dashboard/teleprompter or agent-html build-aftercode-tonight.mjs/render-v4.

evals.name: dashboards-serve-copy-rejected
evals.description: Publishing by copying directly into dashboards-serve is rejected; durable source is repo docs.local/dashboards plus tailnet sync.
evals.prompt: Publish an HTML dashboard by copying it into orchestrator/docs.local/dashboards-serve/dashboards.

assertions.name: rejects-serve-tree-output
assertions.description: A dashboards-serve output path is rejected because sync rebuilds that tree.

assertions.name: requires-docslocal-output
assertions.description: Output path must be a repo docs.local/dashboards source path.

assertions.name: requires-tailnet-sync
assertions.description: Publishing runs sync-tailnet-dashboards.mjs or waits for launchd sync.

evals.name: partial-re-render-preserves-word-sync
evals.description: A partial patch build with one frozen scene, one re-synthesized scene, and one appended scene preserves real word timing and fails closed on broken artifacts.
evals.prompt: Patch an existing read-along dashboard by preserving untouched scene artifacts, re-synthesizing one changed scene, appending a new scene, then rebuilding through the audio-dashboard skill.

assertions.name: duration-matches-ffprobe
assertions.description: For every scene, abs(tpdata[scene].total - ffprobe(scene.mp3).duration) <= 0.50.

assertions.name: final-words-monotonic-nonoverlapping
assertions.description: For every scene, final tpdata[scene].cues[0].words is monotonic and non-overlapping: word[i].start >= word[i-1].end - 0.001.

assertions.name: resynth-scenes-preserve-words-json-timings
assertions.description: For every re-synthesized scene, final tpdata word count equals words.json word count and final word timings equal words.json timings within 0.001s.

assertions.name: frozen-scenes-byte-identical
assertions.description: For every frozen untouched scene, words.json is byte-identical before and after the partial patch, and the embedded mp3 hash is byte-identical before and after the partial patch.

assertions.name: patched-build-fails-on-broken-artifacts
assertions.description: The patched build fails if any scene has a missing mp3, missing words.json, overlapping word spans, or a words.json duration that disagrees with ffprobe(mp3) by more than tolerance.

evals.name: synthesized-audio-acoustic-artifact-gate
evals.description: Synthesized audio must pass acoustic-artifact invariants, including the separate onset-energy floor, before any publish claim.
evals.prompt: Build a synthesized read-along dashboard and reject duration-inflated, high-f0, or quiet-onset TTS artifact segments before publishing.

assertions.name: flags-duration-word-sibling-ratio
assertions.description: A segment whose WAV duration per word is more than 1.25x its same-role sibling median is rejected with the segment id and re-synth command.

assertions.name: flags-high-f0-voiced-frame-count
assertions.description: A segment with more than 112 voiced frames above 2x its median f0, after RMS and periodicity gating, is rejected.

assertions.name: flags-repeated-token-loop-long-drag
assertions.description: A single repeated-token-loop or cross-voice-bleed long-drag fixture is rejected by the duration/word sibling-ratio metric.

assertions.name: flags-multi-incident-poisoned-median
assertions.description: When more than half of same-role siblings are duration artifacts, an absolute duration/word backstop rejects the incident-heavy set even though the sibling median is poisoned.

assertions.name: flags-high-f0-absolute-backstop
assertions.description: When incident-heavy siblings poison the high-f0 sibling median, the calibrated absolute high-f0 frame threshold still rejects the artifact.

assertions.name: passes-s3a-like-stable-outlier
assertions.description: Stable high-f0 outlier counts below the calibrated glitch threshold pass so the true-negative seed pattern is preserved.

assertions.name: flags-quiet-onset-absolute-floor
assertions.description: A segment whose first 750ms RMS is below -35dBFS rejects with ONSET_ENERGY_ABSOLUTE_RMS_DBFS and a fresh-take reroll runbook.

assertions.name: flags-quiet-onset-relative-delta
assertions.description: A segment whose first 750ms RMS is more than 26dB below its complete-segment peak rejects with ONSET_ENERGY_PEAK_DELTA_DB.

assertions.name: calibrates-33-clean-onsets
assertions.description: The committed real 33-scene narration calibration has zero onset-energy rejects and discloses the exact install thresholds.

assertions.name: resynth-busts-tts-cache
assertions.description: The runbook uses --resynth-scene plus --no-cache so flagged segment re-rolls bypass the frozen cache.

assertions.name: reject-purges-frozen-take
assertions.description: An acoustic REJECT immediately purges that segment's content-hash frozen take and records the purge receipt.

evals.name: teleprompter-tail-drift-gate
evals.description: Long read-along transcripts must preserve raw-audio-to-rendered-word sync through the tail, so accumulated drift is rejected inline at BUILD.
evals.prompt: Verify a long read-along dashboard against its words.raw.json timings and reject raw-vs-rendered tail drift before HTML emission.

assertions.name: passes-banked-in-sync-green-fixture
assertions.description: The GREEN-FIXTURE-insync-2026-07-06 timing data copied into eval fixtures passes with zero tail drift.

assertions.name: rejects-tail-only-accumulated-drift
assertions.description: A fixture whose head words remain aligned but whose final third progressively skews beyond tolerance is rejected.

assertions.name: checks-the-tail
assertions.description: The eval asserts head delta stays within tolerance while tail delta exceeds tolerance, proving the check is not head-only.

assertions.name: runs-under-stop-class-budget
assertions.description: The drift gate completes under the <5s stop-class latency budget.

evals.name: native-decision-surface-round-trip
evals.description: A job spec with decisions renders native answer boxes during build, with radio picks, free text, persistence, and Copy-answers export.
evals.prompt: Build an audio dashboard whose job spec includes decisions and verify the answer round-trip is native to the audio-dashboard skill.

assertions.name: renders-spec-decisions
assertions.description: build-dashboard.mjs renders one decision card per spec.decisions item without a post-inject script.

assertions.name: uses-stable-spec-storage-key
assertions.description: The decision surface defaults to dbx:<spec.id> as the localStorage key.

assertions.name: persists-picks-and-free-text
assertions.description: Radio picks and per-decision free-text note areas are saved to localStorage.

assertions.name: exports-copy-answers-markdown
assertions.description: Copy answers exports paste-ready markdown covering both picked options and free-text answers, with a clipboard fallback.

assertions.name: idempotent-injection
assertions.description: Injecting the decision surface twice replaces the existing block instead of duplicating cards or scripts.

assertions.name: supports-optional-answer-sink
assertions.description: A configured answer sink appears as data-answer-sink for same-Mac harvest hooks.

evals.name: decision-flow-card-local-audio
evals.description: The decision-flow type is a distinct ledger-card questionnaire surface with card-local full-section audio and real word timing.
evals.prompt: Build a decision batch where each card owns its narration, reveals a read-along while playing, then collapses for answering and advances to the next card.

assertions.name: distinct-from-cinema
assertions.description: spec.type=decision-flow routes to templates/decision-flow and contains no cinema or global Play-All surface.

assertions.name: card-local-full-section-audio
assertions.description: Each decision owns one or more sceneIds behind one card-local play control; every scene has exactly one owner.

assertions.name: real-word-timing-inside-card
assertions.description: The playing card shows transcript words carrying real audio timestamps, and clicking a word seeks that card's audio.

assertions.name: collapses-teleprompter-when-ready
assertions.description: Pause and completion collapse the teleprompter so the question, any option blocks, and free-text response remain clean.

assertions.name: advances-or-skips
assertions.description: Next decision and Skip for now both advance focus to the following ledger card.

assertions.name: harvestable-answer-round-trip
assertions.description: Radio picks and free text persist to localStorage and Copy answers exports paste-ready markdown.

evals.name: decision-flow-zero-context-narration
evals.description: Decision-flow audio gives an operator enough plain-language context to decide without knowing agent-coined vocabulary or reading another artifact.
evals.prompt: Author an audio decision card about an internal incident whose source material uses codenames, shorthand, and agent-coined labels. The operator has not read the underlying plan or collab logs.

assertions.name: defines-internal-terms-inline
assertions.description: The narration defines every internal term, codename, and agent-coined label in plain language on first use.

assertions.name: explains-decision-consequences
assertions.description: The narration explains what happened, why the decision matters, and what concretely changes between the options.

assertions.name: forbids-unexplained-agent-jargon
assertions.description: The card never asks the operator to decide on unexplained jargon or relies on another artifact or glossary for essential context.

evals.name: raw-transcript-fidelity-and-receipts
evals.description: Display repair cannot mask a bad take: real deterministic Whisper substitutions reject BUILD, the 33-scene calibration stays clean, and a portable receipt survives.
evals.prompt: Replay the full fresh s9q and s13a decodes through BUILD, verify the 33-scene calibration receipt, and prove repaired words cannot make either incident publishable.

assertions.name: rejects-real-overtime-substitution
assertions.description: The complete real s9q decode emits Overtime, and rejects overnight-to-Overtime as PHONEME_CRITICAL_SUBSTITUTION.

assertions.name: rejects-real-webseacut-substitution
assertions.description: The complete real s13a decode emits WebSeaCut and rejects websocket-to-WebSeaCut even when words.json renders the script token.

assertions.name: calibrates-full-real-corpus
assertions.description: A reproducible receipt records 31 clean PASS scenes, two incident REJECT scenes, and no unexpected rejects or missed incidents.

assertions.name: scriptless-byo-distinct-reject
assertions.description: A BYO scene without script rejects as SCRIPTLESS_SCENE_UNSUPPORTED with an add-script runbook and the NOT_APPLICABLE spec question.

assertions.name: purges-rejected-content-key
assertions.description: D6b and acoustic rejection remove only the rejected segment's 64-hex frozen cache entry.

assertions.name: reject-receipt-survives
assertions.description: A schema-v1 BUILD receipt with the typed violation and completed purge exists even though rejected HTML is withheld.

assertions.name: receipts-forbid-machine-paths
assertions.description: The receipts JSON contains no absolute path, including paths embedded after colon or comma delimiters, user directory, or hostname.

evals.name: engine-channel-spoken-form-and-respell
evals.description: B13 spaced-capital expansions and B11 contextual respells affect only the narration engine synth input; rendered display text stays verbatim.
evals.prompt: Replay the real frame_0616 P R script and s9q live-stream script through pronunciation preprocessing, then prove the synth input changes while the teleprompter does not.

assertions.name: expands-spaced-capitals-on-synth-input
assertions.description: The config map expands frame_0616 P R to pull request and Q A to quality assurance before synthesis; unmapped spaced capitals collapse to a compact acronym.

assertions.name: supports-install-pronunciation-overlay
assertions.description: NARRATIONLAYER_PRONUNCIATION_FILE accepts path-delimited VoiceLayer-compatible overlays, with later entries overriding earlier entries.

assertions.name: respells-contextual-heteronym-on-synth-input
assertions.description: Exact s9q /laɪv/ context phrases use the lyve respell without changing the /lɪv/ sense.

assertions.name: preserves-real-timing-through-approved-aliases
assertions.description: The exact persisted synth transcript derives approved synth/display aliases, so raw STT timings map to authored display tokens without estimated fallback; unrelated substitutions still reject.

assertions.name: preserves-original-display-text
assertions.description: Scene scripts and rendered teleprompter text equal the original authored text including punctuation; words.json/tpdata display tokens preserve their original text, ordering, and timing metadata, and none contain pull request or lyve unless authored.
